## Scope

The audit covered 387 graded sets. Each set was read again by a second grader to assess the consistency of the original grading. The review considered whether the first and second grades matched for each set. Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet. These results are also discussed with each grader privately.

## Result

The first and second grades agreed in 66.7 per cent of sets. This indicates that agreement was achieved for most of the reviewed sets, although some differences remained between the initial and second grades. The audit findings should be considered alongside the per-grader results and used to support any follow-up discussion or review.
